messages:
joel_csm: Quick note — Azurea onboarding shows stable p95 ~200ms but p99 bursts to ~1.05s for short assistant turns. They want snappy widget feels. Thinking a small canary: route short-turns (<60 tokens) to compact-2b-int8 + prefix KV cache. Anyone object?

ops_bot: alert: customer=Azurea window=07:10-07:30 p95=0.20s p99=1.05s spike=3.2x

ana_re: Sounds good. Make sure we preserve sampling params and add token-length delta checks. Also flag any tokenization changes for manual review.

mike_eng: I can deploy a 3-hour canary, 30% of short traffic to compact-2b-int8, 70% to standard-7b. Will collect per-variant latency CDF, cache hit rate, and run the small eval set automatically. Config snippet ready.

sara_pdm: Customer ok with slight quality drift if latency and cost improve. Please capture 25 golden prompts for manual QA and set rollback if eval quality drops >1% or p99 worsens.

mike_eng: Canary started 08:05 UTC. 45m update: median -19%, p95 -27%, p99 -23% for short-turns, cache_hit ~38%, no runtime errors. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/azurea/canary-586

ana_re: I'll run the 25-sample QA shortly and post diffs.

ops_bot: canary update: 45m window short_turns p50=-19% p95=-27% p99=-23% cache_hit=38%

mike_eng: Canary completed at 11:10 UTC. Automated eval: quality delta -0.4% (within threshold). Cost sim: ~31% savings. Marking PASS and recommending staged rollout with caching enabled on prod route.

joel_csm: Great — I'll update the onboarding playbook, notify renewal owner of the savings, and schedule a 30-min enablement with the PM tomorrow. Closing thread. :rocket:
